Committee: Finance and Taxation General Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Fund
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/08/2023
Senate Bill 1as introduced appropriates the amount of $59,997,772 from the State General Fund
to the Alabama Trust Fund for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023, to satisfy obligations
of “The Peoples Trust Act”.
